name: 79764 · Odessa, TX
findings: ZIP 79764 (Odessa) has 30 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Arts and cultural organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 79764 (Odessa) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 79764 (Odessa) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 60% of the typical level).
